Name: Fridge Better
Author: brianwbeal
Description:
[b][size=5]Fridge Better[/size][/b]

Expands available storage space in the kitchen fridge and mini-fridges.

Slots are fit to the game window, and paginate with left/right arrows.

Up to 1200 slots.

Customize in `config.json`, or Generic Mod Config Menu.

Manifest.Name: Fridge Better
Manifest.Description: Expands kitchen fridge and mini-fridge capacity, up to 1200 slots shown as pages sized to fit your screen, with arrows to flip between them.
Manifest.Author: brian beal
